dataset.name: UT Southwestern HGSOC ADP-ribosylation cohort (GSE136155)
dataset.description: Independent high-grade serous ovarian-cancer cohort with tumor bulk RNA sequencing and individual recurrence-free survival.
dataset.cohort_context: The source study characterized ADP-ribosylation phenotypes in 34 high-grade serous ovarian cancers and generated bulk RNA sequencing for 22 tumors. TRACE Explorer links those 22 public GEO/SRA libraries directly to the study's Western Blot ID clinical rows. One patient has recurrence-free survival recorded as zero months and is excluded by the positive-time rule, leaving 21 independent patients.
dataset.publication_citation: Conrad et al. Molecular Cancer Therapeutics 2020

metadata.source_program: UT Southwestern high-grade serous ovarian-cancer tissue cohort
metadata.source_data_system: NCBI GEO/SRA uniformly reprocessed by recount3 plus the pinned PMC author-manuscript clinical supplement
metadata.library_method: Bulk tumor RNA sequencing; source reads were aligned to hg19 with Bowtie, while TRACE Explorer uses the same public SRA runs uniformly processed by recount3 against GENCODE v26
metadata.endpoint_context: Recurrence-free survival from diagnosis to recurrence or last follow-up
metadata.endpoint_caveat: The source supplement explicitly defines RFS from diagnosis. Patient18 has RFS equal to zero months and is excluded before endpoint QC. Overall-survival time is public but death status is not, so OS is not exposed.
metadata.sample_selection_note: Each GEO title maps one-to-one to a Western Blot ID and one SRA run. The supplement's RNA Sequencing Y/N field contains labels inconsistent with several deposited GEO titles; eligibility therefore follows the actual GEO/SRA libraries and direct patient IDs rather than that auxiliary flag.
metadata.expression_note: GEO distributes BigWig tracks rather than a compact gene matrix. TRACE Explorer reconstructs expression from the same 22 SRA runs using pinned recount3 GENCODE v26 gene sums, AUC scales to 40 million reads and applies log2(x + 1).
metadata.clinical_evidence_note: The exact NIH author-manuscript XLSX supplement is downloaded through PMC's proof-of-work flow and pinned by byte size and SHA-256. Western Blot ID supplies the direct patient linkage; no inference from the RNA Sequencing Y/N column is made.
metadata.overlap_note: This institutional tissue cohort is independent of TCGA-OV and the other curated ovarian cohorts.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer rebuilds the release from pinned public files and disables direct matrix redistribution because GEO and PMC source terms remain controlling.

samples.sample_role: High-grade serous ovarian-cancer tumor specimen, one bulk RNA profile per patient

expression.label: log2(recount3 AUC-scaled gene coverage + 1)
expression.source_unit: recount3 GENCODE v26 gene-sum base-pair coverage
expression.mapping_source: Pinned recount3 GENCODE v26 (Ensembl 88, GRCh38) annotation
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Versioned Ensembl identifiers are mapped with the matching pinned GENCODE v26 annotation. Symbols assigned to more than one Ensembl identifier are excluded rather than combined implicitly.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer applies the recount3 transform_counts AUC normalization: round(gene-sum base-pair coverage x 40,000,000 / sample AUC), followed by log2(x + 1). The scale supports within-gene comparisons inside this cohort and is not numerically harmonized across studies.

endpoints.label: Recurrence-free survival from diagnosis
endpoints.event_definition: First recurrence; patients without recurrence are censored at last follow-up
